# Scope : Character
# PROVINCE : province
E_kCAFG_set_culture_from_province_random = {
    E_kCAFG_get_random_culture_from_province = {
        PROVINCE = $PROVINCE$
        SAVED_SCOPE = E_kCAFG_set_culture_from_province_random_selection
    }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:E_kCAFG_set_culture_from_province_random_selection }

        culture = { save_temporary_scope_as = kCAFG_old_culture }
        set_culture = scope:E_kCAFG_set_culture_from_province_random_selection
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { scope:kCAFG_old_culture = { has_same_culture_language = scope:E_kCAFG_set_culture_from_province_random_selection } } }
		    unlearn_language_of_culture = scope:kCAFG_old_culture
        }
    }
}
